name: Estimate Builder
summary: A complete estimates and invoices app for a small business, phone first: a money dashboard (waiting to be paid, paid this month, open estimates) over a searchable document list grouped by month with status chips; an editor that saves as you type with customer autocomplete, labour/parts/other line items (reorder, undo), discount in amount or percent, tax per line type, deposit and live balance; a document page with a professional printable estimate or invoice (letterhead from the business tokens, grouped lines, totals, terms, signature line, PAID/VOID stamp), send by text or email, record payments, customer signature, turn an estimate into an invoice, duplicate, void; customers built automatically; insights with charts; settings and backup. Crisp, calm, money-focused.

sections.name: facts
sections.what: Hidden <template id="facts"> holding the business tokens (business, phone, email, address, year) that app.js reads for the app header and the letterhead
sections.edit: Leave the tokens in place; the owner can also change these facts in the app's Settings

sections.name: view-docs
sections.what: Home screen: date eyebrow, h1, New invoice button, sample-data note, a welcome card with 3 steps and buttons when there are no documents, then 3 money stats, search, Estimates/Invoices switch, status chips and the month-grouped list (rows are built in app.js docRow)
sections.edit: Rewrite the h1, the welcome heading/paragraph and the 3 steps in the owner's words (keep one h1, keep data-act and data-if attributes). The stat labels can be renamed; keep their data-t names

sections.name: view-doc
sections.what: One document: header with status pill, money card (total, paid/balance progress, the next step buttons, payments), the printable paper, then Send it / Customer / More / History cards (right column on computers)
sections.edit: Card titles and button words can change; keep data-slot, data-act and no-print classes

sections.name: doc-paper
sections.what: The printable estimate or invoice: letterhead from {{business}} {{address}} {{phone}} {{email}} (Settings can override), Prepared for / Bill to, For, dates, grouped line table, totals with discount, tax and deposit, notes, terms, customer signature and date lines, footer
sections.edit: Keep the tokens and data-t names. Change labels such as Prepared for, Bill to or Customer approval to the owner's wording. Prints black on white on one page for a normal job

sections.name: view-editor
sections.what: The editor (saves as you type): Estimate/Invoice switch, number, dates, customer with autocomplete from past documents, the job (what it is for + notes), work and parts lines with Labour/Parts/Other add buttons, terms, and a totals card with discount ($ or %), tax for this document, deposit and balance; a sticky total bar with Done on phones
sections.edit: Labels and help texts can be reworded for the trade (for example What it is for -> Vehicle). Keep every name= attribute; app.js reads them

sections.name: row-line
sections.what: One line item row (type, description with suggestions from past lines, qty, unit price, amount, drag handle, remove)
sections.edit: Rename the types in the <select> labels only (values labour/parts/other are used by the maths and tax settings)

sections.name: view-customers
sections.what: Customers built automatically from the documents: search, list with what each one owes, billed or was quoted; tap opens a sheet with call/text/email, totals and their documents

sections.name: view-insights
sections.what: 4 stats (billed and collected this month, average invoice, estimates approved), a 6-month billed vs collected bar chart, a donut of labour/parts/other, top customers
sections.edit: Words only; remove a card by deleting its <section> if the owner does not want it

sections.name: view-settings
sections.what: Settings that save as you type: business details on documents, tax name/rate and which line types are taxed, number prefixes and next numbers, validity and due days, usual labour price, currency, starting terms; backup to a file or copied text, restore, CSV export, sample data load/clear, help, erase
sections.edit: Change the default currency option order or help answers if needed; keep names

sections.name: sheets
sections.what: Bodies for the send sheet (editable message, text, email, copy, print, mark as sent), the payment form and the signature pad

behaviors: starts empty with a welcome card; 'Try it with sample data' loads 4 clearly labelled sample documents, 'Clear sample data' removes only those
everything is saved on the phone (AK.store, key estimate-builder) and survives reloads; Settings backs up and restores (file or copied text) and exports CSV

money is worked out in whole cents with half-up rounding: line = qty x unit price; discount (amount or %) comes off before tax and is shared across taxable lines; tax applies per line type (labour, parts, other) at the document's own rate; balance = total - deposit - payments
estimate statuses draft, sent, approved, invoiced, void; invoice statuses draft, sent, part paid, overdue, paid (from payments), void; overdue invoices badge the Documents tab
editor saves as you type, gives a new document the next number (prefix editable), throws away a new document left empty and gives its number back
turn an approved estimate into an invoice (copies lines, customer, tax and deposit), duplicate, void and restore, delete with confirm and undo, remove a line with undo, drag lines to reorder
customer and line descriptions autocomplete from past documents
send: an editable message with total, balance and dates, as a text message (sms:), an email (mailto:) or copied; print or save as PDF prints only the document; customer can sign on screen to approve
phone: bottom tabs and a floating New estimate button; computer: sidebar, two-column editor and document page
style_notes: Built on appkit, so it follows every style; tested at 390 and 1280 with clinical-clean, midnight-neon, neo-brutalist, editorial-serif, soft-pastel and workshop-industrial. Strongest with clinical-clean, swiss-grid, minimal-mono, editorial-serif and workshop-industrial. Status pills use appkit's tuned ok/warn/bad colours (the 'more than one accent colour family' warning is expected). Printing is always black on white.
